# A `${ }` written bare inside braces is put in quotes there, and left bare where its braces are opened.
blueprint: braced

steps:
  count:
    do: emit
    with:
      topic: shop.counted
      data: { rounds: "${ params.rounds + 1 }", of: "${params.item}", plain: as it was }

  listed:
    do: emit
    with: { topic: shop.listed, data: { all: ["${params.first}", "${params.second}", plain, 3] } }

  opened:
    do: emit
    with:
      topic: shop.opened
      data:
        it: ${item}
        long: ${ params.a_rather_long_name_of_something + params.another_long_name }
        why: "${ a ? b : c }"
